rv.q: It is enormous fun, full of heart and undeniably entertaining.
There is fire on the page, but on stage it smoulders and never quite ignites.
The play itself, however, lacks a depth of flavour.
Those in the audience, nearer to the stage, were laughing at the many jokes delivered by the script and were able to enjoy the performance but this reviewer sadly was unable to.

cn.t: Takeaway wins on warmth and heart but loses points for thin plotting. Critics find it crowd-pleasing and full of community spirit, though its lack of dramatic depth leaves some hungry for more substance.
